science_relevance.scientific_problem: Route battery-electric delivery vehicles subject to customer time windows, load limits and recharging requirements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Feasible routing under battery and service constraints is necessary for practical electric freight operations. The task studies a simplified operational planning problem with an independently researched objective.

papers.title: The Electric Vehicle-Routing Problem with Time Windows and Recharging Stations
papers.task_relation: Schneider, Stenger and Goeke formulate and solve E-VRPTW with recharging stations. The local package uses generated instances and its own evaluator, rather than claiming replication of their complete instance set.
papers.primary_goal: Optimize feasible electric-vehicle delivery routes while respecting time windows and battery charging constraints.
